scope: Targeted real-speaker dataset and longitudinal-memory review; not a repeat of the completed daily metadata collection.

records.title: RealPersonaChat: A Realistic Persona Chat Corpus with Interlocutors' Own Personalities
records.verified_methods: The study recruited 233 Japanese participants, collected each participant's own ten-sentence persona and personality questionnaires, and collected repeated free text-chat dialogues. The paper reports Nagoya University ethics approval and prior participant agreement to public release. The released corpus is CC BY-SA 4.0 and masks personal information.
records.personaslm_overlap: Direct real-speaker persona, style, fact, and repeated-history material. It supplies the closest open basis found for an aggregate S/F/H study.
records.decision: Use only pseudonymous aggregate non-impersonation research; keep raw material ignored and local; exclude demographics/personality scales; use speaker- and partner-disjoint partitions; do not publish row-level prompts or generations.

records.title: RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations
records.verified_methods: The preprint reports ten consented human-AI relationships, 27,218 messages over 36-120 days, evidence-linked profile/persona and chat/question items, and a random-sample estimate that 3.4% of messages require earlier context. All released turns are rewritten during anonymization. The authors disclose special-category GDPR data, internal rather than independent ethics review, and no institutional review board.
records.usage_constraints: Controlled access; evaluation and non-weight-changing system study only; no model training; no re-hosting; aggregate publication only; temporary indexes and stores must be deleted after an evaluation.
records.personaslm_overlap: Direct novelty collision for selective long-term memory, restraint, evidence-linked persona reconstruction, and real-conversation reliability. Rewritten wording makes it unsuitable as ground truth for linguistic style fidelity.
records.decision: Do not download in the current study. Treat it as a required restricted F/H reliability comparator if access and governance are later approved; do not claim novelty for merely deciding when history matters.

novelty_update: Simple history injection, history-versus-profile comparison, and generic selective-memory or retrieval-restraint claims are occupied. A defensible PersonaSLM contribution must combine controlled S/F/H effects, valid semantic and style measurement, reliability-fidelity trade-offs, CPU-small-model evidence, and independent validation.
experimental_changes: No frozen experiment is changed. RealPersonaChat is admitted only to a new development pathway; RealCompanion is not downloaded or executed.
limitations: Primary-source claims were reviewed by an AI research agent and are not human-confirmed.
Neither paper's reported model results were independently reproduced.
Dataset permission is not equivalent to permission for identifiable-person imitation.
